items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: That was Dick Vance, Joe Thomas and Roy Eldridge, 1st, 2nd and 3rd.

ctx.x: Couple of other fellows in the band but this voice I didn't know. So, Roy said that's Joe Thomas, the other trumpeter. I said, What do you mean the other trumpeter? There are three up there. And at that time, there was Roy Eldridge, Dick Vance and Joe Thomas.
That was Dick Vance, Joe Thomas and Roy Eldridge, 1st, 2nd and 3rd.

Well, I had it wrong but you three were there and I didn't know Dick Vance either but it wasn't Dick, it was Joe. So, anyway I said to Roy, Do me a favor. Please tell him not to mimic me when I go on the floor because I don't know him and I don't appreciate anybody mimicking me. You can get away with it. Him, whichever one it is, he said, I'll point him out to you. I said, Don't bother. It's not necessary. because I don't like him. But, anyway, to make a long story short, Stanley, he kept right on doing it.

items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: Chu, Buster was there, Joe Thomas.

ctx.x: Was Chu already with him then?
Yeah. Chu was with the band before I was. That's probably why I was with the band. I think Chu must have told him to get me. Chu, Buster was there, Joe Thomas.
